t: You're on Hampstead Road, in the London Borough of Camden. It's part of the A400, a road that runs from Charing Cross up to Archway in North London, passing some of the city's most famous landmarks. General Charles FitzRoy, 1st Baron Southampton, is buried here. He was an army officer, courtier and politician who served in the Seven Years' War. He fought at the Battle of Minden in 1759, and sat in the House of Commons from 1759 to 1780. He died in 1797.
